title: Keep the Light
style_prompt: Clear educational indie pop, warm female vocal, crisp diction, light acoustic guitar and handclaps, memorable chorus, no heavy reverb

instruments: handclaps and light drums for rhythm
arrangement.arc: Intimate guitar verse, brighter handclap chorus, reduced bridge, final chorus with piano and vocal harmonies

vocal.format: female lead with light chorus harmonies
vocal.diction: crisp consonants and clearly separated target words
vocal.delivery: encouraging and intimate in verses, confident and melodic in the chorus

words.example: I caught a glimpse of the moon between the clouds.
If you persist, the difficult steps become easier.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: I caught a glimpse of morning through the rain
A glimpse of something bright beyond the grey

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Persist, persist, take one more step
Hold that glimpse and don't forget
Persist, persist, the road will clear
A glimpse of hope is waiting here
